description: A taxonomic is-a relationship directed from a child Organism to its parent. It connects NCBI taxa to their immediate taxonomic parents and BV-BRC strain-level genome records to their NCBI taxon. Following these edges toward parents traverses the organism taxonomy. The NCBI root (taxid 1) is excluded, so top-level taxa have no outgoing ISA_OiO edge.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: The source of the relationship: "ncbitaxa" for NCBI taxonomic lineage edges or "BV-BRC" for strain-to-taxon edges.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the edge was created.

source_contributions.scope: Taxonomic lineages for bacteria selected from KEGG, viruses selected from PathoPhenoDB and VirHost, human-host pathogens selected from PHI-base, and their ancestors. Homo sapiens and SARS-CoV-2 are always included. Additional lineages cover taxa represented by qualifying BV-BRC strains. The artificial NCBI root is excluded.
source_contributions.description: Parent-child taxonomy relationships between NCBITaxon-identified Organism nodes, spanning the represented taxonomic ranks and supplying paths from specific organisms to broader ancestral groups. KEGG, PathoPhenoDB, VirHost and PHI-base determine scope; the lineage relationships themselves come from NCBI Taxonomy.

source_contributions.scope: Non-deprecated BV-BRC genome records with a taxon and at least one populated descriptive or AMR-availability field from the documented inclusion filter. The associated NCBI parent taxon must be represented. Unresolvable taxon identifiers are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Links each represented BVBRC-identified strain-level genome record to its NCBITaxon-identified taxon. Separate genome records remain separate strain observations even when they share a parent taxon. Where NCBI has merged an old taxon identifier, the relationship uses the current taxon.
